description: FreeCAD's PlaneGCS 2D variational constraint solver, vendored per ADR-016. LGPL-2.1-or-later; see LICENSE. Only native/kernel-host/src/sketch_solver.cpp may include these headers (ADR-016 seam law).
notes: upstream/ is UPSTREAM and unmodified; sha256 pinned below so an edit or a re-vendor drift is detectable.

The DIRECTORY DEPTH of upstream/ is load-bearing: the vendored headers include "../../SketcherGlobal.h" by relative path, so App/planegcs/ must sit two levels under the file that satisfies it. Flattening the tree breaks the build.
ADR-016 says '11 files'. It is TWELVE: SketcherGlobal.h is reached by that relative include and is upstream LGPL code too. Recorded rather than quietly rounded.
shim/ is OURS, not upstream: FreeCAD's export macros, a minimal Base/Console.h, and three boost includes.

TWO of the three boost includes are genuinely dead (graph_concepts -> <cassert>, math/constants -> <cmath>). The THIRD IS NOT: GCS.cpp:1783-1801 calls add_vertex/add_edge/num_vertices/connected_components inside diagnose(), so shim/boost_graph_adjacency_list.hpp is a live union-find on the DoF/redundancy path and carries its own tests in the solver gate.
